LSO.note: The abstract discusses data privacy in e-commerce but states nothing about a general data protection law.

facts.fact: A National University of Lesotho thesis by Sephoso (2025) is titled as studying the 'absence of electronic commerce legislation' in Lesotho.
The National University of Lesotho published a 2025 thesis by Sephoso on e-commerce legislation, data privacy and cybersecurity in Lesotho.
